evidence_gaps: Full tender bases, annexes, capacity measurement boundary and augmentation permissions not reviewed.
No project award, OEM quotes, warranty retention curves, cycling/temperature data or supplier compatibility evidence.
No validated installation outage, recharge, grid-forming or ancillary-service design.
limitations: Synthetic capacity-cost screen only; no tender compliance, revenue, realised savings or investment approval.
Constant annual retention per cohort is an assumption, not a calibrated calendar/cycle ageing model. Costs are constant-real USD at service start; no FX, taxes, debt or price forecast.
Each addition is installed instantly at the start of its interval; old cohorts remain in service. Compatibility, outages and commissioning must be separately established.
100% initial SOC and a fixed reserve/discharge-efficiency factor apply to one four-hour service event. Recharging and repeated dispatch are not modelled.

Battery capacity-variable installed costs, fixed augmentation-event costs and capacity-based O&M only. Common inverter, solar/wind, land and grid costs cancel; no terminal salvage or disposal difference is valued.
End-of-year checks bound intervening capacity only under monotone assumed fade and constant power/SOC factors; power quality, dynamic derating and all other tender duties remain untested.
